title: Maximum and Minimum Sums of at Most Size K Subarrays
summary: Given an integer array and a positive integer k, calculate the sum of the maximum and minimum elements for every subarray containing at most k elements.
statement: Given an integer array and a positive integer k, calculate the sum of the maximum and minimum elements for every subarray containing at most k elements.
constraints: nums has 1–100,000 integers and 1 <= k <= len(nums).
Consider every nonempty contiguous subarray whose length is at most k.
Return the sum of each subarray’s minimum plus maximum.
hints: For each right endpoint, maintain the sum of maxima and minima of every allowed suffix.
Use monotonic block deques whose share counts say how many suffixes currently choose each extreme.
Merge dominated blocks when appending, remove one share when the left limit advances, and add both running sums.
Each suffix contributes to one block; block merging updates exactly the suffixes whose extreme changes.
editorial: Each suffix contributes to one block; block merging updates exactly the suffixes whose extreme changes.
